skill.summary: PowerShell skill for calling Kakao Local API to normalize addresses and search places with keyword, location, radius, and category filters.

latestVersion.changelog: v0.1.0: Initial release. Kakao Local API helpers for NormalizeAddress & SearchPlace (PowerShell 5 + curl.exe). UI publish uses text-only packaging: script/config sources are embedded under references/ as Markdown (copy out to use locally).
